newsitem.title: USA: Unigene says osteoporosis tests promising.
newsitem.headline: Unigene says osteoporosis tests promising.

text.p: Unigene Laboratories Inc said on Thursday that its new osteoporosis pill apparently surpassed performance targets in clinical trials.

Unigene has completed the dosing regimen for its injectable FORTICAL product, and is awaiting independent statistical analysis of the data. But the treatment appears to be doing well in the tests, the company said.
The formal study reports will be incorporated into the company's applications for marketing authorization in both the U.S. and Europe.
